    The free groupoid on a quiver is free #

    Quiver.FreeGroupoid V with generating arrows the arrows of V satisfies IsFreeGroupoid (Mathlib's universal property against groups), by the universal property of the free groupoid (Quiver.FreeGroupoid.lift). So its vertex groups are free when it is connected (IsFreeGroupoid.endIsFreeOfConnectedFree).
